verdict.rationale: Version history fits a note-taking and sync product, so the axis applies, but no evidence item documents viewing a page's version history, restoring earlier versions, or recovering deleted notes. The Logseq Sync docs cover only device sync and encryption. The logseq.Git plugin namespace is a developer building block, and community setups using git repos or Syncthing are user-side workarounds, so neither earns credit.
